insurer_name: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; worldwide emergency hospitalization available
specific_diseases_listed: Stones in biliary and urinary systems
Chronic Renal Failure/end stage Renal Failure
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Grace period 15 days monthly / 30 days quarterly-half yearly-yearly; free look 30 days; renewable lifelong

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to sum insured; modern treatments up to 50% of SI
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes diagnostics, OT, ICU, intravenous fluids, blood transfusion, prosthetic devices implanted during surgery

day_care_treatments.notes: Including chemotherapy, radiotherapy, hemodialysis; less than 24 hours admission

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Continuous treatment ≥ 3 days; pre/post hospitalization payable

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Up to Rs. 50,000 per delivery, after 2-year waiting period; max 2 deliveries per female member during lifetime of policy
maternity_coverage.notes: Miscarriage payable only if due to accident

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Newborn covered from birth (policy year) up to base SI if maternity claim accepted; vaccination sub-limit Rs. 10,000 in first year

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Second Opinion for 11 critical illnesses (Cancer, First Heart Attack, CABG, Heart valve replacement/repair, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Permanent paralysis of limbs, Motor Neurone Disease, Multiple Sclerosis)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Once per policy year; once per lifetime for same illness

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Re-load of 100% of Individual Base Sum Insured of any one member once per policy year
restoration_benefit.notes: Triggers when base SI + NCB + floater SI insufficient; for different illness/injury

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual health check-up for prescribed tests, over and above base SI; subject to renewal

disease_wise_sub_limits.nutrition_allowance_post_delivery: Up to Rs. 10,000 paid two months post-discharge
disease_wise_sub_limits.emergency_domestic_evacuation: Up to Rs. 1 lakh (part of SI; once per policy)

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide Emergency Hospitalization on reimbursement basis

notable_exclusions_summary: Family floater with maternity (Rs. 50,000), reload, worldwide emergency, and 11 CI second opinion. Excludes adventure sports, refractive error, cosmetic surgery, infertility and OPD (except preventive checkup).
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Royal Sundaram network hospitals (MediAssist TPA 04068213621 / Paramount TPA 1800226655); reimbursement within 30 days of discharge. Customer Services 1860-258-0000 / 1860-425-0000. TAT pre-auth 1 hour, final bill 3 hours.
available_riders: Hospital Cash (max Rs. 60,000 per insured for 30 days hospitalization)
